title: Give the Specialist a Smaller Tool Surface
tagline: Do not give a subagent a capability that it must not use.

story.problem: The first version delegated research with eve's built-in `agent` tool. That tool runs a copy of the ROOT agent, with the same instructions and the same tools, which include `send_outreach`. Nothing looked wrong, and the plans were good. But the child agent inherited the capability to email a stranger; nobody granted it. One bad inference was sufficient for the child agent to use that capability.
story.solution: Move the research into a declared subagent at `agent/subagents/scout`. Its full tool surface is web search plus `record_vendor`. Declared subagents inherit nothing, so you author the disabled shell tools and the observability hook again under that directory. Then shadow eve's built-in `agent` tool with an authored refusal. `disableTool()` does not cover a built-in tool, and a rule in a prompt is not a control.
story.outcome: The capability is absent, not forbidden: research and outreach never share a context. In a later production session, the planner still tried both delegation paths — 10 `scout` calls and 3 `agent` calls in one session. That behavior is the reason to shadow the built-in tool and not only to warn against it.

prerequisites: Node 24.x and this repository checked out — the commands inspect the real agent, not a sample
eve ^0.24.4; `eve build` writes the `.eve/agent-summary.json` manifest the checks read
NEBIUS_API_KEY in .env.local if you intend to run the agent rather than only inspect its tool surface
Familiarity with agent/lib/models.ts — planner and scout are separate roles on purpose

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Set NEBIUS_API_KEY and TAVILY_API_KEY in .env.local. The tool-surface checks in this recipe need no keys; npm run eval:scout does.
quickstart.run: npm run build:eve && jq -r '.tools[].name' .eve/agent-summary.json && grep -L disableTool agent/subagents/scout/tools/*.ts
